about: Stage 8b high bars approved by beenster 17 Nov 10:48 ('these look great - LETS GO!'). Proposed pool entries (bars) for the Bikes V2 thread. Geometry: import foundry/highbars3d.py (it registers these keys into bars3d.BARS and swaps in its bar_half), then bars3d.fit(build3d, model, c, bar, grip, end, fin) as for any stage 1 bar. Same clamp at the bike's riser point and the same straight 22.2 mm grip section, so stage 2 controls ride on them. The rider's hands move 166-386 mm: the pose must read the hand point from the bar (bars3d.hand_point after importing highbars3d).
check: python3 foundry/highbars3d.py check: full 30 degree lock clear of the tank on lodestar_chopper and lodestar_cruiser; no clashes.
